impact_summary.value: 세 제품에서 표시되지 않은 디클로페낙이 확인되어 소비자에게 심혈관·위장관 손상 등 위해가 발생할 수 있고, 제품은 미승인 신약 및 허위·오인 표시 의약품으로 지적되었습니다.

evidence.quote: FDA confirmed through laboratory analysis that a sample of your “Kuka Flex Forte,” “Reumo Flex,” and “Artri King Reforzado con Ortiga y Omega 3” contains undeclared diclofenac.

NSAIDs may cause increased risk of cardiovascular events, such as heart attack and stroke, as well as serious gastrointestinal damage, including bleeding, ulceration, and fatal perforation of the stomach and intestines.

affected_work.value: 대상은 Kuka Flex Forte, Reumo Flex, Artri King Reforzado con Ortiga y Omega 3 제품의 성분 및 표시사항, 그리고 해당 제품의 웹사이트 판매·홍보입니다.

evidence.quote: This letter is to advise you that the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) reviewed your website at the Internet address https://botanical-be.com/ in July 2023, where you take orders for “Kuka Flex Forte,” “Reumo Flex,” and “Artri King Reforzado con Ortiga y Omega 3” products.

recommendation.value: FDA는 위반을 시정하기 위해 취한 구체적 조치와 재발 방지 단계 및 관련 자료를 서면으로 제출하라고 요구합니다. 기한 내 시정이 어렵다면 지연 사유와 완료 예상 기간을 밝혀야 합니다.

evidence.quote: Please notify FDA in writing, within fifteen working days of receipt of this letter, of the specific steps you have taken to correct any violations. Include an explanation of each step being taken to prevent the recurrence of violations, as well as copies of related documentation.
If you cannot complete corrective action within fifteen working days, state the reason for the delay and the time within which you will complete the correction.
